notes: The opening continues an earlier discussion and associates the inserted savoir-symbol with the displayed values p=-1, g=l_0^alpha l_1^beta, alpha+beta=1, q=-1 and r=1, followed by ou mieux, beta=-1. The extra closing parenthesis after alpha,beta in Z is visible and preserved. No algebraic correction or verification is claimed.

The author says that replacing L_0 with L_1 in the preceding calculations replaces g by rho(g), with q and r unchanged. He introduces, in addition to the cyclotomic character chi, numerical and quotient-valued functions beta and gamma on a group named Gamma. The action phi(alpha) dot g = l_0^alpha g l_1^-alpha and the application (gamma,chi) are transcribed as written.

The author states that this application is injective and that beta is determined by gamma, whose values are classes satisfying a relation continued beyond the sheet. The oblique marginal note calls gamma_0 a 1-cocycle and describes a subgroup through the inserted words qui définit. These are the author’s assertions, not checked results.

Every C deletion and insertion has a separate inventory entry and second-pass coverage. The six cancelled-word doubts remain because the crossing strokes prevent a full letter-by-letter recovery. The unstruck marginal insertion qui définit is resolved on the saved crop. The word une in the final phrase satisfaisant une relation is legible despite H’s uncertainty.

The main and marginal NB headings are underlined. The inserted beta has a distinct underline and a comma; the thinner oblique guide is separate. The comma is placed within the insertion in the proposed text. Root independently accepted these strokes; the later blind audit reopens the separate header numeral as4/9.

There is no date or explicit authorial uncertainty phrase such as peut-être or a question in this sheet. Ou mieux is an authorial reformulation and is retained. The head number is now uncertain4/9, with4 preferred;10 at the lower right is clear. Both have separate H-omission rows; the editorial scan identifier 11 is excluded from omission counting.

No mathematical check, external research, OCR, recognition software or TeX compilation was used. The whole-page image and both original halves were read once; one enlarged crop was saved for each selected locus. The twelve original crops plus the distinct previously uncropped header numeral make thirteen saved crops. A batched display of three already-created crops was truncated by the tool before usable visual output, so those saved images were subsequently inspected individually without making additional crops.

The main reader compared the two new group-name signs on their existing crops: both have a long doubled left stem and a short right tip on the top bar, supporting Γ rather than H’s Π. The indexed pi in the definition has curved feet. These local comparisons are paleographic and do not impose a case decision on every earlier group sign. The beta insertion has a distinct dark underline below its body and a comma at its lower right, separate from the lighter diagonal guide.

The blind audit restores the insertion state of the raised à after the group definition and of the raised marginal map, and the unclosed square bracket before the marginal cancellation. The manuscript has a low point after1 in1. cocycle rather than the editorial hyphen initially used. The definition label is now dfn/def, with dfn preferred from its final shoulder; no accent is supplied. Several cancelled recoveries are broadened without resolving them. The independent capital-Pi readings were compared with the explicit pi annotation and hooked unindexed examples on this same sheet; the local pi notation is retained. No mathematical check is claimed for these paleographic decisions.
